messages:
Sofia: Heads-up — invoice INV-26-998 from HelioNimbus routed to AP today but landed against PO-998 (old network PO). Attachment: INV-26-998.pdf. Seems like vendor changed naming.
Raj: I see it in the queue. Auto-match confidence 0.87 but matched to PO-998 (dept: Network). The invoice description references 'model-serving GPUs' which should be Cloud Infra / Eng.
Carla: Do we have a PO for model-serving? I think PO-8998 is the current one for infra burst capacity.
FinanceBot: Invoice INV-26-998 received. Auto-match: PO-998 (confidence 0.87). Suggested GL=3001-Network, Amount=$4,980.00.
Sofia: That's wrong GL. This spend belongs to Eng model infra (GL 4012). Can we remap?
ProcurementBot: Vendor HelioNimbus has multiple vendor aliases: HelioNimbus LLC, Helio Nimbus Inc. System matched vendor_id=VN-233. Duplicate vendor records detected. Recommended merge request: PROC-887.
Raj: If we change the PO mapping we'll need AP approval and an approver change. Current approver for PO-998 is Ben (Network Director). Approver for PO-8998 is Carla (Eng Finance).
Sofia: Carla — will you approve remap to PO-8998? Payment timing: this is due in 5 days.
Carla: I can approve if procurement confirms PO-8998 covers these SKU lines. Can someone paste the invoice line items?
Sofia: OCR snippet:
```
Line 1: Model-serving GPU hours x 120 @ $38/hr = $4,560
Line 2: Data egress surcharge = $420
Total = $4,980
PO ref on invoice: PO# 8998 (handwritten)
```
Handwritten PO was faint; OCR sometimes drops a 9.
AP_Team: Noted. We can perform a manual PO remap but need a written confirmation from Procurement and an approver from Eng Finance. Also need vendor consolidation ticket completed to prevent future misroutes.
ProcurementBot: Manual remap request created: PROC-8998-REMAP. Please attach approval comment.
Ben: Ben here — I received a notification about this. I did not authorize charges for model-serving GPUs under PO-998. Putting a hold on payment while this is sorted.
Carla: Confirmed PO-8998 scope includes burst GPUs through 04/2026. I approve remap for INV-26-998 to PO-8998 and GL 4012-CloudOps. Approval note: "Carla approves remap; invoice lines match PO-8998."
Sofia: Thanks Carla. AP team — please update invoice record and re-route approval to Carla.
AP_Team: Updated. Invoice INV-26-998 remapped to PO-8998, GL set to 4012-CloudOps. Payment status: Held -> Pending approval. JIRA FIN-3344 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-3344
FinanceBot: Payment hold released conditionally when vendor consolidation PROC-887 completes. Added user note: "Follow-up with Procurement to merge duplicate vendor records to prevent misrouting."
Raj: I'll assign PROC-887 to procurement this afternoon and tag vendor duplicates for cleanup.
Sofia: Closing loop here — monitoring until PROC-887 done. If vendor sends duplicate invoices we should block until resolved.
Carla: :white_check_mark: Thanks everyone.
Ben: Keep me posted if anything else comes up.
Sofia: Will do. Invoice will be paid once consolidation and credit checks are clear.
